blocks.prompt: 4 (i) Sum to \(n\) terms the series: \(1 + (a - b) + (a^{2} + ab + b^{2}) + (a^{3} + a^{2}b + ab^{2} + b^{3}) + \cdots\)
blocks.explanation:
Is series ka har bracket khud ek chhoti G.P. hai. (Doosra term kitab mein \((a - b)\) chhapa hai; pattern aur answer key ke mutabiq yeh \((a + b)\) hai, neeche "Kitab ki ghalti" dekhein.)
Plan: \(k\)th term ko ek fraction \( rac{a^{k} - b^{k}}{a - b}\) banayenge, phir series ko do G.P. mein tod kar dono ka sum lenge (\(a 
eq b\), \(a 
eq 1\), \(b 
eq 1\) maan kar).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(1 + (a + b) + (a^{2} + ab + b^{2}) + \cdots\), \(n\) terms tak.
Humein find karna hai: \(S_n\).
Tareeqa: General term identity (pehchaan) \(a^{k} - b^{k} = (a - b)(a^{k-1} + a^{k-2}b + \cdots + b^{k-1})\) se ek fraction banega. Seedha jama karna mushkil hai kyunke har bracket mein terms ki tadaad badhti jati hai.

\(k\)th term nikalein
\[T_k = a^{k-1} + a^{k-2}b + \cdots + b^{k-1}\]
\[= \dfrac{a^{k} - b^{k}}{a - b}\]
Kyun: Brackets ko ghaur se dekhein: doosre mein powers 1 tak, teesre mein 2 tak, chauthe mein 3 tak. \(k\)th bracket \(a^{k-1}\) se shuru hota hai, phir \(a\) ki power ek ek kam aur \(b\) ki ek ek zyada hoti hai. Chhoti misaal: \(a^{2} - b^{2} = (a - b)(a + b)\) aur \(a^{3} - b^{3} = (a - b)(a^{2} + ab + b^{2})\).

Pehle terms par formula check karein
\[T_1 = \dfrac{a - b}{a - b} = 1\]
\[T_2 = \dfrac{a^{2} - b^{2}}{a - b} = a + b\]
Kyun: General term ko series ke asal terms dene chahiye; dono match kar gaye, to formula theek hai.

\(n\) terms jama karein
\[S_n = \dfrac{1}{a - b}\left[(a + a^{2} + \cdots + a^{n}) - (b + b^{2} + \cdots + b^{n})\right]\]
Kyun: Har term ka denominator \(a - b\) ek hi hai, is liye use bahar nikal liya. Andar \(a\) ki saari powers ek group mein aur \(b\) ki saari powers doosre group mein.

Dono G.P. ka sum
\[a + \cdots + a^{n} = \dfrac{a(1 - a^{n})}{1 - a}\]
\[b + \cdots + b^{n} = \dfrac{b(1 - b^{n})}{1 - b}\]
Kyun: Pehli G.P. ka pehla term \(a\), ratio \(a\), \(n\) terms. Doosri ka pehla term \(b\), ratio \(b\), \(n\) terms. Formula \(\frac{a_1(1 - r^{n})}{1 - r}\) dono par laga.

Ek fraction mein jorein
\[S_n = \dfrac{1}{a - b}\left[\dfrac{a(1 - a^{n})}{1 - a} - \dfrac{b(1 - b^{n})}{1 - b}\right]\]
\[= \dfrac{a(1 - b)(1 - a^{n}) - b(1 - a)(1 - b^{n})}{(a - b)(1 - a)(1 - b)}\]
Kyun: Do fractions ghatane ke liye common denominator \((1 - a)(1 - b)\) liya: pehli fraction ko upar neeche \((1 - b)\) se aur doosri ko \((1 - a)\) se multiply kiya.
Dhyan dein: Bracket ke bahar wala \(\frac{1}{a - b}\) bhool na jayein; woh neeche ja kar \((a - b)\) banta hai.

Tasdeeq: \(n = 2\)
\[\text{top} = a(1 - b)(1 - a^{2}) - b(1 - a)(1 - b^{2})\]
\[= (1 - a)(1 - b)(a - b)(1 + a + b)\]
Kyun: \(1 - a^{2} = (1 - a)(1 + a)\) aur \(1 - b^{2} = (1 - b)(1 + b)\); \((1 - a)(1 - b)\) common nikalne par andar \(a + a^{2} - b - b^{2} = (a - b)(1 + a + b)\) bachta hai. Neeche wale se divide karein to \(1 + (a + b)\) bacha, jo pehle do terms ka sum hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein doosra term \((a - b)\) chhapa hai. Series ke pattern (\(k\)th term \(a^{k-1} + a^{k-2}b + \cdots + b^{k-1}\)) aur answer key ke mutabiq yeh \((a + b)\) hona chahiye: series \(1 + (a + b) + (a^{2} + ab + b^{2}) + \cdots\) hai. Upar ka hal \((a + b)\) le kar kiya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt: 4 (ii) Sum to \(n\) terms the series: \(r + (1 + k)r^{2} + (1 + k + k^{2})r^{3} + \cdots\)
blocks.explanation:
Yahan \(r\) ki har power ke aage jo bracket hai, woh \(k\) mein ek chhoti G.P. hai.
Plan: \(n\)th term ko \( rac{1 - k^{n}}{1 - k}r^{n}\) likhenge, series ko do G.P. (ek \(r\) mein, ek \(kr\) mein) mein todenge aur dono ka sum lenge (\(k 
eq 1\), \(r 
eq 1\), \(kr 
eq 1\) maan kar).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(r + (1 + k)r^{2} + (1 + k + k^{2})r^{3} + \cdots\), \(n\) terms tak.
Humein find karna hai: \(S_n\).
Tareeqa: Pehle bracket ko \(k\) ki G.P. samajh kar us ka sum likhenge, phir poori series ko do saaf G.P. mein tod denge. Yeh (i) wala hi tareeqa hai.

\(n\)th term nikalein
\[T_n = (1 + k + \cdots + k^{n-1})r^{n}\]
\[= \dfrac{1 - k^{n}}{1 - k}\,r^{n}\]
Kyun: Pehle term mein bracket 1 hai, doosre mein \(1 + k\), teesre mein \(1 + k + k^{2}\). To \(n\)th term ke bracket mein \(n\) terms hain: G.P. jis ka pehla term 1 aur ratio \(k\) hai. Us ka sum \(\frac{1 - k^{n}}{1 - k}\).
Dhyan dein: Bracket \(k^{n-1}\) par khatam hota hai, \(k^{n}\) par nahi; is liye terms ki tadaad \(n\) hai.

Term ko simplify karein
\[T_n = \dfrac{1}{1 - k}\left[r^{n} - (kr)^{n}\right]\]
Kyun: \(r^{n}\) ko upar multiply kiya: \(r^{n} - k^{n}r^{n}\), aur \(k^{n}r^{n} = (kr)^{n}\). Ab har term do saaf powers ka farq hai.

\(n\) terms jama karein
\[S_n = \dfrac{1}{1 - k}\left[(r + \cdots + r^{n}) - (kr + \cdots + (kr)^{n})\right]\]
Kyun: Har term ke aage \(\frac{1}{1 - k}\) hai, use bahar nikala. \(r\) ki powers ek group mein aur \(kr\) ki powers doosre mein.

Dono G.P. ka sum
\[r + \cdots + r^{n} = \dfrac{r(1 - r^{n})}{1 - r}\]
\[kr + \cdots + (kr)^{n} = \dfrac{kr(1 - k^{n}r^{n})}{1 - kr}\]
Kyun: Pehli G.P.: pehla term \(r\), ratio \(r\). Doosri: pehla term \(kr\), ratio \(kr\). Dono mein \(n\) terms. \((kr)^{n} = k^{n}r^{n}\).

Sab jorein
\[S_n = \dfrac{1}{1 - k}\left[\dfrac{r(1 - r^{n})}{1 - r} - \dfrac{kr(1 - k^{n}r^{n})}{1 - kr}\right]\]
\[= \dfrac{r}{1 - k}\left[\dfrac{1 - r^{n}}{1 - r} - \dfrac{k(1 - k^{n}r^{n})}{1 - kr}\right]\]
Kyun: Dono fractions ke upar \(r\) hai, use bahar nikal diya taake jawab saaf ho aur answer key wali shakal ban jaye.

Tasdeeq: \(n = 1\)
\[\dfrac{r}{1 - k}\left[1 - k\right] = r\]
Kyun: \(n = 1\) par \(\frac{1 - r}{1 - r} = 1\) aur \(\frac{k(1 - kr)}{1 - kr} = k\), to bracket \(1 - k\) bana aur \(\frac{1}{1 - k}\) se cancel ho gaya. Jawab \(r\) aaya, jo series ka pehla term hai.
